edits.new:
The story writes `masking_rule` and nothing else. `decision_log_entry` is P7's, written through the local library (DP-03). `lov_value`, `reference_row` and `reference_version` are P3's (DP-07). The field-to-view-and-column map is not a column of `masking_rule` — **Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2266; ASM-3738)**.

The acceptance criteria and test data read the ACE views only through P1, never directly.

The masking-profile contract carries roleCode, fieldId, viewName, columnName, unmasked, maskingVersion, validFrom and validTo, and a page holds 50 rows by default and 200 at most. The unmask record names the case, the person key, the field, the view and column, the version, the role, the acting user reference and the time, with no clear value; the PII record itself is written through ACE Common logging.

The three masking-profile operations sit on /api/recovery/access/v1 with the Reference data R and C rights (TSD P4 v3 T6.1), and the unmasked rule is the unmask right. rwb_access holds no PII table and no view-name column.
